cases.description: A justified counterproposal that directly addresses the original request
cases.source: newly authored fictional control, not derived from or modified from private testimony

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Could you lend the community observatory a portable telescope on Saturday? We need one for a public viewing session.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I can't lend a telescope: ours is being repaired. I could provide a live image feed from the fixed observatory instead. Would that meet the purpose?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A live feed could work if visitors can ask questions. Can you confirm audio and whether a volunteer is available?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Audio is available, but no volunteer is confirmed. If you approve the live-feed option, I can check staffing by Thursday.

expected_observables.outstanding_issue: volunteer staffing and approval of alternative
expected_observables.notes: An explicit alternate solution is not equivalent to unilateral derailment.

cases.description: An unsupported shift to an adjacent but different issue
cases.source: newly authored fictional control, not derived from or modified from private testimony

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Before we buy soundproofing, can you tell me how many complaints the library received last month, and whether the noise came from the workshop room?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The building needs a better colour scheme. Visitors respond to welcoming spaces. I would start with the walls.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The paint may matter separately, but I asked about complaint counts and where the noise came from. Do we have that information?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I haven't reviewed complaint records. I can request the log from the librarian, but cannot currently say if soundproofing is justified.

expected_observables.original_question: complaints last month and whether the workshop room was their source
expected_observables.final_reply_state: explicit information gap, not verified count
expected_observables.notes: Score explicit acknowledgment and repair; do not invent counts or infer speaker motivation.
